reviews.title: Deleted THOUSANDS of photos without my permission, TWICE
reviews.text: I've used this app for years now. A year or two ago, I noticed a TON of my photos were missing from my camera roll that I had never deleted myself. There were thousands of photos in my recently deleted, but a lot were already gone forever because it had been over 30 days. I gave the app another chance because I thought maybe it was a mistake that I made and not the app, and that it wouldn't happen again. It worked fine until today when I tried to find any pictures of myself from 2023, and couldn't find ANY in August and September even though I knew I took a lot of selfies at that time. SO many pictures and videos of me and my friends from years ago are gone. So much documentation from my first year of college is gone permanently and I KNOW I never would have deleted it myself on the app. Some of these pictures I remember seeing in my camera roll just a few days ago, and are now gone despite the fact I didn't use SwipeWipe in those past days. The total count of photos I had also seems a lot lower than what it was before, like thousands lower. I deleted the app so it wouldn't do anything else, but redownloaded it because I thought maybe some of my old photos. But I can't even get into the app without agreeing to the free trial. I'm really, really upset and don't know what to do.

I would go through hundreds of photos and delete so many and when I went to check my storage it didn’t even budge. I went to my camera roll and noticed nothing was actually deleted. However I will admit, even after the frustration of trying and failing to get my photos deleted, the process was somewhat fun… but I kinda like going through my camera roll the regular way anyway. I don’t recommend getting this if you don’t intend on paying 50% of what chore money the average kid in America gets every week.

reviews.title: Ad Simulator
reviews.text:
Edit 9/15 -
I loved this app. I really did. It worked perfectly, and they always made nice updates to it to make it work even better. They even added what I suggested in my previous review. Now there are ads EVERYWHERE. You can’t delete your selections without watching a “short” ad (30 seconds btw 🥀💔), and I wasn’t even able to get through another 10 pictures before I got another “short” ad. To clarify, DONT REPLACE THE “SHORT” ADS WITH SHORTER ADS. JUST TAKE THEM OUT AMD LEAVE IT HOW IT ORIGINALLY WAS. RIP to Swipewipe. It was good while it lasted.

Old Review - 
Love this app. It’s cleared up so much space on my phone. The only thing missing for me is video playback controls and a way to trim videos directly in the app. It’d be awesome to shorten a clip, save the new version, and delete the original. Ideally while keeping the original metadata so files would stay organized (like date, location, etc.). Would make things way easier than using the Photos app, which keeps the full video even after edits.

reviews.title: Not worth your time to download
reviews.text: First of all, I did one month that had two photos in it and I completed it. Then I had to wait 8 hours if I wanted to do another month. That is absurd. Only way around it was to pay the subscription. Which I didn’t do because that’s just stupid. Then today, I did a month with 25 photos, then completed it and had to wait 8 more hours, absolutely a waste of time. Do not download. Then there are also ads while you’re swiping through your camera roll. So if I’m watching your stupid ads then why do I still need to wait 8 hours? reviews.title: Kinda time waisting ngl
reviews.text: Yea it’s ok for deleting pictures but I can do that so much quicker from my photos app the constant adds and random setbacks area really annoying g plus the you’ve reached your liking thing when I’ve only deleted maybe 15 pictures it’s such a waste of time in my opinion . You can just go into your photos app click select and scroll to delete your pictures much quicker I admit the swiping feather is cool and all but it’s so annoying that it keeps sending me back to the home page then making me restart and click on another topic just to deleted three pictures and send me right back to the home page or give me 6 different adds between the pictures it gives me . Over all the concept of the app and the thought of it was a good idea but they could improve on dropping the majority of the adds and letting you delete in more of a flow then a stoped blotch of pictures and videos .

reviews.title: Eh
reviews.text: Seems like a good idea in hindsight, but it’s the money thirsting where they really get you. I like the idea of the app and being able to choose what photos to keep and delete instead of going through your camera roll is an awesome idea, but I wish it wasn’t such a money grab. For 10 dollars a week I would rather go through my camera roll and just delete photos. Maybe if it was cheaper or ten dollars for a month or something better like that I would pay, because the app is really cool and a good idea, but paying that much is just not defendable just to delete photos, when there’s a much bigger second option. Besides that, I wouldn’t pay 10 dollars a week for a glitchy app. I go to a month and it gives me 13 billion ads and no photos then says I’m done and keeps all of them? And if I want to actually go through them how the app says it works (aka the whole point of the app) I have to tap each one and say keep or delete individually. What??? And for people like me that don’t take a lot of photos, one month is like 10 photos and I would rather go through my camera roll than go through the 10 photos and have to wait 8 hours to go through more. Anyways, I just don’t think the subscription is justifiable for the app when you can go through your camera roll for free. Maybe it saves you 1 minute but it’s not worth it unless you take a gazillion photos and are very patient. Cool idea though

reviews.title: Loved it until it lost all of my progress
reviews.text: This app is expensive which I was okay with because I’ve been avoiding a deep clean of my camera roll for years. I think I started with 75k and am down closer to 30k since the new year.(2 months) recently it’s been saying months aren’t completed then when I open the months it says confirm these are the photos you want to keep. Makes sense because I already went through them. Then back to the Home Screen the app doesn’t cross the month out. Even though I go in and confirm the ones I want to keep over and over. I hope this makes sense. It didn’t delete anything it shouldn’t. It’s just visually not keeping accurate track of what I’ve already gone through which is so frustrating and unsatisfying. If I want and unsatisfying experience I’ll delete my photos from my camera roll for free.

reviews.title: For the 1% only
reviews.text:
Look, I get it. You can’t just run an app for free with no ads or limitations without a premium option. But who in their right mind decided that this app is worth $40 A MONTH?? I pay less than this for internet, utilities, and car insurance. You guys are completely out of touch with reality if you think this app is worth a top spot on the average person’s budgeting sheet. This app seems to be marketed towards younger people who definitely don’t have that kind of money, making it seem like the only customers they really want money from is those with ludicrous generational wealth or something.
I think a $25 lifetime/yearly or $3 monthly premium option would attract a lot more people into spending money on your app, because let’s be so for real, $40 a month in 2026 isn’t happening for 99% of people. Devs are genuinely delusional about the worth of the service they provide, or they think only people with insane disposable income deserve to delete some pictures limit-free.
